The strength of the evidence is moderate, as the scores indicate a partial confidence in the relationship, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction. The mechanism is not fully elucidated, but the evidence points to a possible regulatory pathway involving the compound and cis-Isopinocamphone.
